comment: File-refs `yarn docs:file-refs:check` may find missing without failing (ADR 0093). Every entry names the Markdown file that makes the claim, the claim token, and a written reason. An entry without a reason is rejected. An entry is stale — and fails — when the documenting file is gone, the claim is no longer made, or the named file exists again. Frozen Research Briefs under docs/research/ are skipped as a class (ADR 0041) and do not belong here.
